 Update: added new Roll a Stickman codes on October 23, 2026
 If you want to build an unstoppable army of stickman characters to take down powerful enemies, Roll a Stickman is where you’ll get a complete package. You can roll for rare cards, strengthen your collection, and battle enemies to become more powerful. So, use this list of the latest Roll a Stickman codes to get free rolls, potions, crates, card tomes, and other useful rewards. 
 All New Roll a Stickman Codes
 DUNGEON : 4 of each dungeon ticket ( NEW , stage 100+) Copy 
 HALLOWEEN : 5 Pumpkin Eggs ( NEW , stage 100+) Copy 
 6KLIKES : Instant rolls, 21 potions, 6 Crates, 25 Card Tomes, 20 Trait Rerolls, 4 Base Keys, 1 Stat Reset, and 1 Grow Potion ( NEW , stage 100+) Copy 
 3KLIKES : Instant rolls, 21 potions, 6 Crates, 25 Card Tomes, 20 Trait Rerolls, 4 Base Keys, 1 Stat Reset, and 50 gems Copy

 200LIKES : Instant rolls, 17 potions, 4 Crates, 20 Card Tomes, 15 Trait Rerolls, 3 Base Keys, and 1 Stat Reset (stage 100+) Copy 
 50LIKES : Instant rolls, 13 potions, 3 Crates, 15 Card Tomes, 12 Trait Rerolls, 2 Base Keys and 1 Stat Reset Copy

 Expired Roll a Stickman Codes
 Currently, there are no expired codes in the game, so make sure you get the rewards right away.
 Looking for more experiences worth trying out? Check out +1 Venom Evolution , Shigaku , Smash a Piggy , and Start Your Blue Lock Career . If you want to explore more experiences, check out our  Roblox game codes  master list to find more freebies for them.
 How to Redeem Roll a Stickman Codes
 Before you redeem the codes for Roll a Stickman, join the official community called Ultrain Studios to be eligible for freebies. Now, you can follow the steps below:
 Launch Roll a Stickman on your Roblox app.
 Click on the Menu icon in the top-right corner of the screen.
 Click on the Codes tab and then enter a working code in the text box of the new window.
 Click on the  Redeem button to get all your free rewards.
 How to Get More Roll a Stickman Codes
 Since new codes can arrive with milestone completions or with major updates, it’s best to join the Roll a Stickman Discord server. You can find the list of new codes in the major channels here. You also need to join their official community and like the game to get some free in-game rewards.
 If you feel finding the new codes in this game is a bit hectic, consider bookmarking our page and checking back again to find the list of new rewards. We update this list frequently, and therefore you will not miss out on the rewards.
 Why Are My Roll a Stickman Codes Not Working?
 Start by checking if you have entered the code correctly. Even a small typo or extra space counts as an invalid code. So, consider copying and pasting the codes directly from our list. If the code is still not working, consider exiting the game and rejoining it with a newer server. 
 That is all for the codes for Roll a Stickman. So, what are some of the best stickman cards you have in the game right now? Tell us in the comments below.
